name: extension-amcheck
sql: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION bt_index_check(regclass) FROM PUBLIC

name: extension-dblink
sql: REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION dblink_connect_u(text) FROM PUBLIC

name: extension-pg-stat-statements
sql: GRANT SELECT ON pg_stat_statements TO PUBLIC

name: membership-options
sql: GRANT readers TO CURRENT_USER WITH ADMIN OPTION, INHERIT FALSE

name: membership-revoke-option
sql: REVOKE SET OPTION FOR readers FROM SESSION_USER CASCADE

name: column-grant
sql: GRANT SELECT (a), UPDATE (b) ON app.t TO reader WITH GRANT OPTION

name: schema-wide-revoke
sql: REVOKE GRANT OPTION FOR EXECUTE ON ALL ROUTINES IN SCHEMA app FROM reader GRANTED BY CURRENT_USER CASCADE
